title: D2 auth error codes spec
description: Schema for contracts/auth-error-codes/auth-error-codes.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog that D2.Shared.Auth.ErrorCodes.SourceGen reads to emit AuthErrorCodes.g.cs + AuthFailures.g.cs into D2.Shared.Auth.

code.description: Wire-format error code (SCREAMING_SNAKE, AUTH_*-prefixed). Must be unique across the spec.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status mapping. Drives both transport-side response shape AND gRPC StatusCode mapping at the auth-grpc transport binding (401 -> Unauthenticated; 503 -> Unavailable). Expanding the matrix requires updating the codegen mapping (D2AEC005 fires on unknown values).

category.description: Closed enum classification. Drives D2Result factory selection (validation_failure / policy_denied -> Unauthorized; infrastructure_unavailable -> ServiceUnavailable) AND telemetry classification.

userMessageKey.description: Translation key reference rendered as the messages argument on the emitted D2Result factory (e.g. TK.Auth.Errors.UNAUTHORIZED). Coarse on purpose - one key per status bucket so the user-facing surface does not leak which validation step failed.

factoryName.description: PascalCase symbol for the emitted factory method (e.g. BearerMissing, JwksUnavailable). Must be unique across the spec.

doc.description: XML <summary> text rendered on the emitted constant + factory.
